title: deck proposed agenda
description: GATE 4's artifact: what the next meeting is for, what is on it, and WHAT IS BEING LEFT OUT AND WHY. The exclusions are the half that makes this reviewable - an agenda that only lists what it includes cannot be checked for what it quietly dropped. `deck gate agenda` requires every unresolved decision and every pending action in the ledger to appear in one list or the other.

when.description: As the PO said it. 来週火曜 is a legitimate value.

why.description: Why this belongs on the NEXT meeting's agenda. Not a restatement of the heading.

wants.description: What the agent wants out of the room for this item.

ledger_refs.description: Which ledger entries this item rests on. An agenda item resting on nothing in the source is the agent's own idea, and must be marked as such with an explicit `agent_proposed` ref.

missing_evidence.description: What the agent wanted and could not find in the source. Shown to the PO at gate 4 so they can supply it rather than discover the hole in the meeting.
